Any.description: Placeholder range for slots whose value type is enumerated in any_of.
Any.title: Any

Claim.description: A statement to be checked against sources. The input a fact-checking agent reads.

context.description: Where the claim was made or why it is being checked.

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

subject_uri.description: What the claim is about, if it has an identifier.

Claim.title: Claim

ConversationTurn.description: One earlier turn of a conversation, as the caller presents it to the agent. An agent turn names the agent and version that produced it and the invocation it came from.

turn_agent_id.description: For an agent turn, the agent that produced it.

turn_agent_version.description: For an agent turn, the version of the agent that produced it.

turn_invocation_id.description: For an agent turn, the invocation it came from.

turn_text.description: What was said in the turn.

ConversationTurn.title: ConversationTurn

DatasetProfile.description: A minimal description of a dataset being planned or prepared: what it is about and how it is shaped. Every slot maps onto an external vocabulary rather than a Data Director namespace.

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

themes.description: Discipline or subject, as free text or an IRI.

DatasetProfile.title: DatasetProfile

Delegation.description: One child invocation an agent in grounding mode delegation made through the workbench (ADR-0012). Recorded by the conductor from its own run of the child, never reported by the agent. content_hash is the dd-envelope-json-v1 hash of the child envelope, which is what a relayed reply cites.
Delegation.title: Delegation

Envelope.description: The agent's response. Every field an agent did not decide (identifiers, timestamps, telemetry) is filled by the conductor, so an agent cannot mislabel its own run. Conditional rules not expressible in JSON Schema are enforced by contract.validate: failed or suspended requires problem; abstained or referred requires outcome.reason_code; succeeded requires payload.

agent_id.description: Stable identifier of the agent, e.g. r3.standards-advisor or stub.abstain.

conversation_id.description: UUIDv7 shared by every turn of one conversation. On a child invocation, the parent's.

delegations.description: The child invocations this invocation delegated to, in the order they ran.

grounding_mode.description: The grounding contract the agent declared and the linter applied. Filled by the conductor from the agent's specification, never by the agent.

invocation_id.description: UUIDv7 (RFC 9562), time-ordered so the append-only store sorts without an index.

parent_invocation_id.description: The invocation that delegated this one. Set only by the conductor, from a delegation grant; a caller's request that carries it is refused.

payload.description: Agent-specific payload; absent unless the outcome is succeeded. One of the payload classes, discriminated by schema_class; every one mixes in Grounded.

requires_human_review.description: Always true (C13, C15). Emitted as a constant so no consumer can produce an envelope claiming otherwise.

Envelope.title: Envelope

EvidenceItem.description: The retrieved content a grounding claim rests on, identified by a hash over its canonicalised projection (not the HTTP body).

content.description: The document the named canonicalisation turns into bytes, already projected, so that a reader or the linter (E1) can recompute content_hash from the envelope alone (ADR-0015). Where a payload cites this item from grounded_on, this is what the citation identifies.

snapshot_ref.description: Which copy of the registry answered, e.g. snapshot:2026-09-04 or live.

EvidenceItem.title: EvidenceItem

FactCheck.description: The payload of a fact-checking agent: a verdict on a Claim and the rationale for it, grounded on the sources consulted.

grounded_on.description: The retrieved things this object rests on. For grounding mode retrieval, each entry names a retrieval span; for input_only and none, the single entry is the input itself (source_id input:<invocation_id>, content_hash the dd-input-json-v1 hash).

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

FactCheck.title: FactCheck

criterion.description: The quality criterion assessed, e.g. licence_present.

grounded_on.description: The retrieved things this object rests on. For grounding mode retrieval, each entry names a retrieval span; for input_only and none, the single entry is the input itself (source_id input:<invocation_id>, content_hash the dd-input-json-v1 hash).

message.description: The finding, as a sentence a reviewer can act on.

Greeting.description: The payload of the hello.world template agent: one greeting, grounded on the Salutation it was derived from. Exists to demonstrate the payload contract, not to do anything.

greeting_derivation.description: How greeting_text came about. Always template for this agent.

grounded_on.description: The retrieved things this object rests on. For grounding mode retrieval, each entry names a retrieval span; for input_only and none, the single entry is the input itself (source_id input:<invocation_id>, content_hash the dd-input-json-v1 hash).

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

Greeting.title: Greeting

Grounded.description: Mixed into every payload class and every item class that asserts an identity. The linter walks a payload document for grounded_on lists and never needs to know the payload class; a payload that lacks grounded_on at its root is a violation, not a pass.

grounded_on.description: The retrieved things this object rests on. For grounding mode retrieval, each entry names a retrieval span; for input_only and none, the single entry is the input itself (source_id input:<invocation_id>, content_hash the dd-input-json-v1 hash).

Grounded.title: Grounded

GroundingMode.description: The grounding contract an agent declares. The linter applies a rule set per mode (ADR-0008); an envelope always records which one applied.
GroundingMode.title: GroundingMode

GroundingRef.description: The identity and content hash of one retrieved thing a payload rests on. The only way a payload may name an external resource as a decided identity, and the only place it names it: what the reference identifies is read from the evidence item with the same source_id and content_hash (ADR-0015). The linter matches every GroundingRef against a retrieval span on both fields.
GroundingRef.title: GroundingRef

InvocationRequest.description: What the conductor hands to an agent. One request produces exactly one Envelope. A conversation is the set of top-level invocations sharing a conversation_id; each turn is one request and one envelope (ADR-0012).

agent_id.description: Stable identifier of the agent, e.g. r3.standards-advisor or stub.abstain.

conversation_id.description: UUIDv7 shared by every turn of one conversation. On a child invocation, the parent's.

input.description: What the agent is asked to work on. One of the input classes, discriminated by schema_class; an agent declares which it accepts.

invocation_id.description: UUIDv7 (RFC 9562), time-ordered so the append-only store sorts without an index.

parent_invocation_id.description: The invocation that delegated this one. Set only by the conductor, from a delegation grant; a caller's request that carries it is refused.

policy_bundle_ref.description: Reference to the institutional profile the conductor applied (path or profile:<id>).

requirement_ids.description: Blueprint or project requirement identifiers the invocation is exercising.

InvocationRequest.title: InvocationRequest

Message.description: One conversational turn addressed to an agent: the text of the turn and the conversation so far. The history is part of the input, so the input hash covers everything the agent saw.

history.description: The earlier turns of the conversation, oldest first.

message_text.description: What the user said in this turn.

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

Message.title: Message

MetadataRecord.description: An existing metadata record about a dataset, as a repository or catalogue holds it. The input a quality or validation agent assesses. Slots are the DCAT and Dublin Core terms a minimal record carries; TODO widen when a real repository export is exercised.

identifier.description: The record's own identifier, e.g. a DOI or a catalogue URI.

licence.description: The licence the record declares, as an IRI or SPDX identifier.

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

MetadataRecord.title: MetadataRecord

Outcome.description: One class rather than a union of five. The status enum carries the vocabulary; reason_code is required when status is abstained or referred; problem (on the Envelope) is required when status is failed or suspended.

referred_to.description: The human role a referred outcome hands to, e.g. data_steward.

statement.description: A human-readable sentence explaining the outcome (C14).

Outcome.title: Outcome

OutcomeStatus.description: The outcome vocabulary. The Blueprint does not define one; this is the workbench's specification contribution.
OutcomeStatus.title: OutcomeStatus

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details for HTTP APIs, used verbatim for failed and suspended outcomes. The two extension members carry the resumption condition for suspended.

resume_after.description: Earliest time a suspended invocation may resume (extension member).

resume_condition.description: What must happen for a suspended invocation to resume (extension member).

ProblemDetails.title: ProblemDetails

QualityReview.description: The payload of a quality or validation agent: a score over an existing record and the findings behind it. Grounded on the input itself (grounding mode input_only or none).

grounded_on.description: The retrieved things this object rests on. For grounding mode retrieval, each entry names a retrieval span; for input_only and none, the single entry is the input itself (source_id input:<invocation_id>, content_hash the dd-input-json-v1 hash).

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

QualityReview.title: QualityReview

ReasonCode.description: Why an agent abstained or referred. Adapted from the standards-advisor experiment's NothingFoundReason.
ReasonCode.title: ReasonCode

Recommendation.description: One recommended resource for one target. The resource is named only in grounded_on; its name, status and DOI are in the cited evidence item's content (ADR-0015).

grounded_on.description: The retrieved things this object rests on. For grounding mode retrieval, each entry names a retrieval span; for input_only and none, the single entry is the input itself (source_id input:<invocation_id>, content_hash the dd-input-json-v1 hash).

target.description: dataset, or field:<name> for a field-level recommendation.

Recommendation.title: Recommendation

Recommendations.description: The R3 payload. Recommended vocabularies, ontologies and formats.

grounded_on.description: The retrieved things this object rests on. For grounding mode retrieval, each entry names a retrieval span; for input_only and none, the single entry is the input itself (source_id input:<invocation_id>, content_hash the dd-input-json-v1 hash).

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

Recommendations.title: Recommendations

Reply.description: The payload of a conversational agent: the text of its reply. An orchestrator's reply is grounded on its input and on the envelopes of the invocations it delegated to.

grounded_on.description: The retrieved things this object rests on. For grounding mode retrieval, each entry names a retrieval span; for input_only and none, the single entry is the input itself (source_id input:<invocation_id>, content_hash the dd-input-json-v1 hash).

reply_derivation.description: How reply_text came about. template for a rule-based agent, model for a model.

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

Reply.title: Reply

Salutation.description: Whom to greet. The input of the hello.world template agent: the smallest input class the contract admits, and the worked example for adding one (see agents/hello/).

language.description: BCP 47 tag for the language to greet in. English if absent.

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

Salutation.title: Salutation

SearchedSummary.description: What was looked for, so a reader can judge an abstention as well as a recommendation.

snapshot_ref.description: Which copy of the registry answered, e.g. snapshot:2026-09-04 or live.

SearchedSummary.title: SearchedSummary

TableField.description: One field of a tabular resource, mirroring a Frictionless Table Schema field descriptor. Frictionless publishes no RDF namespace, so these slots carry see_also rather than a slot_uri (TODO: revisit if Frictionless publishes term IRIs).

field_type.description: Frictionless field type (string, number, integer, boolean, date, datetime, time, duration, geopoint, ...).

TableField.title: TableField

Telemetry.description: Run measurements. The energy slots exist so P14 can be populated later without a schema change; at v0 they are null and not_measured.

trace_id.description: OpenTelemetry trace identifier, 32 lowercase hex characters.

Telemetry.title: Telemetry

TurnRole.description: Who spoke in a conversation turn.
TurnRole.title: TurnRole
